title: pellaea deltoidea
intro: Pellaea deltoidea, commonly known as False Bracken, is a type of fern native to the southern and western parts of North America. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea deltoidea include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
